自己.en: They had a culture of their own.

了解.pinyin: Tā xiǎng jìn yī bù liǎo jiě tā men

节日.zh: 圣诞节绝对是我最喜欢的节日。

节日.en: Christmas is definitely my favorite holiday.

把握.en: You should make good use of this opportunity.

把握.zh: 我很后悔当时没有把握机会认识她。
把握.pinyin: Wǒ hěn hòu huǐ dāng shí méi yǒu bǎ wò jī huì rèn shi tā
把握.en: I regret missing the chance to meet her.
把握.es: Me arrepiento de haber perdido la oportunidad de encontrarme con ella.

把握.zh: 你所要做的便是好好把握这千载难逢的机会。
把握.pinyin: Nǐ suǒ yào zuò de biàn shì hǎo hǎo bǎ wò zhè qiān zǎi nán féng de jī huì
把握.en: All you have to do is take advantage of this rare opportunity.

把握.zh: 勇气是一个奇怪的东西：没有任何人对它有把握
把握.pinyin: Yǒng qì shì yī ge qí guài de dōng xi méi yǒu rèn hé rén duì tā yǒu bǎ wò
把握.en: Courage is a strange thing: One can never be sure of it.

业余.zh: 我的业余爱好是拍野花的照片。
业余.pinyin: Wǒ de yè yú ài hào shì pāi yě huā de zhào piàn
业余.en: My hobby is taking pictures of wild flowers.

业余.zh: 她把所有的业余时间都用在钓鱼上了。
业余.pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒ yǒu de yè yú shí jiān dōu yòng zài diào yú shàng le
业余.en: She devoted all her spare time to fishing.

业余.zh: 观察鸟类是个很好的业余爱好。
业余.pinyin: Guān chá niǎo lèi shì gè hěn hǎo de yè yú ài hào
业余.en: Bird watching is a nice hobby.

人物.zh: 我一直都比较喜欢神秘一点的人物。
人物.pinyin: Wǒ yī zhí dōu bǐ jiào xǐ huan shén mì yī diǎn de rén wù
人物.en: I always liked mysterious characters more.
人物.es: Siempre me gustaron más los personajes misteriosos.

人物.zh: 我一直都更喜欢有些神秘的小说人物。
人物.pinyin: Wǒ yī zhí dōu gèng xǐ huan yǒu xiē shén mì de xiǎo shuō rén wù
人物.en: I always liked mysterious characters more.
人物.es: Siempre me gustaron más los personajes misteriosos.

人物.zh: 他是一位脑满肠肥的人物。
人物.pinyin: Tā shì yī wèi nǎo mǎn cháng féi de rén wù
人物.en: He's a rich man and a real maggot.

人物.zh: 只有小说人物才会有一辈子不改变的性格。
人物.pinyin: Zhǐ yǒu xiǎo shuō rén wù cái huì yǒu yī bèi zi bù gǎi biàn de xìng gé
人物.en: Only in novels do you find individuals who live out their whole life with unvarying character.

册.zh: 戴蒙给我看了他的邮票册。
册.pinyin: Dài méng gěi wǒ kàn le tā de yóu piào cè
册.en: Damon showed me his stamp album.
册.es: Damon me mostró su álbum de sellos.

册.zh: 他的书仅仅一月前出版了，且已经卖了一千册。
册.pinyin: Tā de shū jǐn jǐn yī yuè qián chū bǎn le qiě yǐ jīng mài le yī qiān cè
册.en: His book was published just one month ago, and it has already sold thousands of copies.
册.es: Su libro fue publicado hace solo un mes y ya vendió miles de copias.

册.pinyin: Tā yǒu duō shao cè tú shū
册.en: How many books does he have?

册.zh: 请您在登记册上签名好吗？
册.pinyin: Qǐng nín zài dēng jì cè shàng qiān míng hǎo ma
册.en: Could you please sign the register?

多余.zh: 事实证明了我们的担心是多余的。
多余.pinyin: Shì shí zhèng míng le wǒ men de dān xīn shì duō yú de
多余.en: The facts proved that our worries were unnecessary.
多余.es: Los hechos demostraron que nuestras preocupaciones fueron innecesarias.

多余.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu duō yú de yào shi ma
多余.en: Do you have an extra key?

多余.pinyin: Hái yǒu duō yú de yán ma

多余.zh: 街上的乞丐问：“你还有多余的钱吗？”
多余.pinyin: Jiē shang de qǐ gài wèn nǐ hái yǒu duō yú de qián ma
多余.en: The beggar on the street asks: "Do you have any extra euros?"

明星.zh: 谁是你最喜爱的电视明星？
明星.pinyin: Shéi shì nǐ zuì xǐ ài de diàn shì míng xīng
明星.es: ¿Quién es tu estrella de la televisión preferida?

慌张.zh: 汤姆在表达自己的意见的时候总是很慌张。
慌张.pinyin: Tāng mǔ zài biǎo dá zì jǐ de yì jiàn de shí hou zǒng shì hěn huāng zhāng
慌张.en: Tom never felt comfortable expressing his own opinion.

简历.zh: 我根本不在乎我的简历。
简历.pinyin: Wǒ gēn běn bù zài hu wǒ de jiǎn lì
简历.en: I don't give a damn about my CV.

简历.zh: 我还从来都没有写过简历呢！
简历.pinyin: Wǒ hái cóng lái dōu méi yǒu xiě guo jiǎn lì ne
简历.en: I still haven't ever written a resumé!

综合.zh: 所有意见是真相和错误的综合。
综合.pinyin: Suǒ yǒu yì jiàn shì zhēn xiàng hé cuò wù de zōng hé
综合.en: Every opinion is a mixture of truth and mistakes.
综合.es: Toda opinión es una mezcla de la verdad y de errores.

综合.pinyin: Dé yǔ shì zōng hé yǔ
综合.es: El alemán es un lenguaje sintético.

分布.zh: 苗瑶语系的语言分布於东南亚和中国南方山区。
分布.pinyin: Miáo yáo yǔ xì de yǔ yán fēn bù yú dōng nán yà hé zhōng guó nán fāng shān qū
分布.en: Languages in the Hmong-Mien language family, also referred to as the Miao-Yao language family, are spoken across Southeast Asia and mountainous areas of southern China.

联络.pinyin: Wǒ gēn fù mǔ lián luò le yī xià

联络.zh: 我明天回来的时候会跟他们联络。
联络.pinyin: Wǒ míng tiān huí lai de shí hou huì gēn tā men lián luò
联络.en: I'll call them tomorrow when I come back.

联络.zh: 对不起, 你要联络的人没空。
联络.pinyin: Duì bu qǐ nǐ yào lián luò de rén méi kōng
联络.en: We are sorry, the person you are trying to contact is not available.
联络.es: Lo sentimos, la persona con quien quieres contactar no está disponible en este momento.

联络.pinyin: Ràng wǒ men bǎo chí lián luò

台风.zh: 暴风雨发展成了一个台风。
台风.pinyin: Bào fēng yǔ fā zhǎn chéng le yī ge tái fēng
台风.en: The storm developed into a typhoon.
台风.es: La tormenta se hizo un tifón.

台风.pinyin: Yòu kāi shǐ guā tái fēng le
台风.en: A typhoon has also started to rise.
台风.es: El huracán comienza a soplar de nuevo.

台风.pinyin: Tái fēng zào chéng le hé shuǐ fàn làn
台风.en: The typhoon caused the river to flood.
台风.es: El tifón causó que el río se desbordara.

台风.zh: 由于台风原因，很多航班被取消了。
台风.pinyin: Yóu yú tái fēng yuán yīn hěn duō háng bān bèi qǔ xiāo le
台风.en: Many flights were canceled, owing to the typhoon.
台风.es: Se cancelaron muchos vuelos por culpa del tifón.

拜托.pinyin: Bài tuō bié liú wǒ yī gè rén
拜托.es: No me dejes solo, por favor.

拜托.pinyin: Bié gào su tā bài tuō nǐ le

拜托.zh: 拜托你开门让我进来吧。
拜托.pinyin: Bài tuō nǐ kāi mén ràng wǒ jìn lái ba
拜托.en: Open the door and let me in, please.
拜托.es: Abre la puerta y déjame entrar, por favor.

拜托.zh: 拜托您，请给我一张签证。
拜托.pinyin: Bài tuō nín qǐng gěi wǒ yī zhāng qiān zhèng
拜托.en: I beg you, give me a visa.
拜托.es: Se lo suplico, deme por favor un visado.

尴尬.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà ràng wǒ hěn gān gà
尴尬.es: Lo que él dijo me dio vergüenza.

尴尬.pinyin: Kàn jiàn wǒ tā hěn gān gà
Wǒ rèn wéi zhè hěn lìng rén gān gà
Tā de huà ràng wǒ hěn gān gà

角落.zh: 坐在角落的那个男人是谁？
角落.pinyin: Zuò zài jiǎo luò de nà ge nán rén shì shéi
角落.en: Who is the man sitting in the corner?
角落.es: ¿Quién es ese hombre que está sentado en la esquina?

角落.zh: 汤姆正站在房间的角落。
角落.pinyin: Tāng mǔ zhèng zhàn zài fáng jiān de jiǎo luò
角落.en: Tom is standing in the corner of the room.
角落.es: Tom está parado en la esquina de la habitación.

角落.zh: 他可能还在世界的某一个角落里生存着。
角落.pinyin: Tā kě néng hái zài shì jiè de mǒu yī ge jiǎo luò lǐ shēng cún zhe
角落.en: He could still be alive somewhere.
角落.es: Él podría seguir vivo en algún lado.

角落.zh: 人类居住在世界的每一个角落。
角落.pinyin: Rén lèi jū zhù zài shì jiè de měi yī ge jiǎo luò
角落.en: Humans live in every corner of the world.
角落.es: Los hombres viven en todas las partes del mundo.

魔鬼.pinyin: Mó guǐ bī wǒ zhè me zuò de
魔鬼.en: The Devil made me do it.
魔鬼.es: El diablo me obligó a hacerlo.

魔鬼.pinyin: Zhè rén bǎ líng hún mài gěi mó guǐ
魔鬼.en: The man sold his soul to the devil.
魔鬼.es: El hombre le vendió su alma al demonio.

魔鬼.zh: 地狱空空荡荡，魔鬼都在人间。
魔鬼.pinyin: Dì yù kōng kōng dàng dàng mó guǐ dōu zài rén jiān
魔鬼.en: Hell is empty, and all the devils are here!
魔鬼.es: ¡El infierno está vacío! ¡Aquí están los demonios!

魔鬼.pinyin: Wǒ zài gěi mó guǐ dāng biàn hù shì
魔鬼.en: I'm just playing the devil's advocate.

凶手.zh: 凶手承认了自己的犯罪。
凶手.pinyin: Xiōng shǒu chéng rèn le zì jǐ de fàn zuì
Tā què rèn tā shì shā rén xiōng shǒu
凶手.en: She identified him as the murderer.
凶手.es: Ella le identificó como el asesino.

凶手.zh: 他是个凶手，应该进到牢里。
凶手.pinyin: Tā shì gè xiōng shǒu yīng gāi jìn dào láo lǐ
凶手.en: He is a killer, he should be behind bars!
凶手.es: ¡Es un asesino, debería estar entre rejas!

凶手.zh: 警察逮捕了谋杀这位小姐的凶手。
凶手.pinyin: Jǐng chá dài bǔ le móu shā zhè wèi xiǎo jie de xiōng shǒu
凶手.en: The police arrested the man who had murdered the girl.
凶手.es: La Policía arrestó al hombre que asesinó a la niña.

嫌.zh: 不要对人家送的礼物挑三拣四，嫌东嫌西的。
嫌.pinyin: Bù yào duì rén jiā sòng de lǐ wù tiāo sān jiǎn sì xián dōng xián xī de
嫌.en: Don't look a gift horse in the mouth.
嫌.es: A caballo regalado no le mires el diente.

嫌.zh: 多听不多言, 里外人不嫌。
嫌.pinyin: Duō tīng bù duō yán lǐ wài rén bù xián
嫌.en: He that hears much and speaks not at all shall be welcome both in bower and hall.

跌.pinyin: Hòu shì jìng diē le xià lai

跌.zh: 再走一步的话，你就已经跌下楼梯了。
跌.pinyin: Zài zǒu yī bù de huà nǐ jiù yǐ jīng diē xià lóu tī le
跌.en: Another step, and you would have fallen down the stairs.

跌.zh: 温度计上的温度跌到了零度以下。
跌.pinyin: Wēn dù jì shàng de wēn dù diē dào le líng dù yǐ xià
跌.en: The thermometer went down below zero.

跌.pinyin: Tā men chà diǎn diē xià yǐ zi
跌.en: They nearly fell off their chairs.

田野.zh: 阳光照亮田野，痛苦点亮心灵。
田野.pinyin: Yáng guāng zhào liàng tián yě tòng kǔ diǎn liàng xīn líng
田野.en: Sun lights the landscape, pain illuminates the soul.
田野.es: El sol ilumina el paisaje, el dolor ilumina el alma.

田野.zh: 今天天气晴朗，孩子们在田野里玩耍。
田野.pinyin: Jīn tiān tiān qì qíng lǎng hái zi men zài tián yě lǐ wán shuǎ
田野.en: Today the weather is magnificent and the children play in the fields.

田野.pinyin: Liè rén zài tián yě zhuī tù zi
田野.en: The hunter chases the rabbit in the fields.

田野.zh: 一条小路跨过桥梁，穿过田野，还爬上小丘。
田野.pinyin: Yī tiáo xiǎo lù kuà guò qiáo liáng chuān guò tián yě hái pá shàng xiǎo qiū
田野.en: A small road ran across the bridge, through the fields, and over a hill.

新郎.zh: 新郎现在在一家公司工作，新娘是我们的老师。
新郎.pinyin: Xīn láng xiàn zài zài yī jiā gōng sī gōng zuò xīn niáng shì wǒ men de lǎo shī
新郎.en: The groom works for a company now, and the bride is our teacher.

新郎.zh: 发给好朋友的请帖上有新郎新娘合影的照片。
新郎.pinyin: Fā gěi hǎo péng you de qǐng tiě shàng yǒu xīn láng xīn niáng hé yǐng de zhào piàn
新郎.en: There's a photo of the bride and groom together on the invitation sent to friends.

新郎.zh: 请诸位斟满酒，为新郎和新娘干杯！
新郎.pinyin: Qǐng zhū wèi zhēn mǎn jiǔ wèi xīn láng hé xīn niáng gān bēi
新郎.en: Please charge your glasses and drink a toast to the bride and groom!

否决.zh: 他们为什么否决了你的建议呢？
否决.pinyin: Tā men wèi shén me fǒu jué le nǐ de jiàn yì ne
否决.en: Why did they turn down your proposal?

否决.zh: 我从来没否决过我对你有感情。
否决.pinyin: Wǒ cóng lái méi fǒu jué guo wǒ duì nǐ yǒu gǎn qíng
否决.en: I've never denied that I have feelings for you.

否决.zh: 美国总统有权否决与退回法案。
否决.pinyin: Měi guó zǒng tǒng yǒu quán fǒu jué yǔ tuì huí fǎ àn
否决.en: The President of the United States has the power to veto and send back legislation.

嘈杂.zh: 日本是一个非常嘈杂的国家。
嘈杂.pinyin: Rì běn shì yī ge fēi cháng cáo zá de guó jiā
嘈杂.en: Japan is an extremely noisy country.
嘈杂.es: Japón es un país extremadamente ruidoso.

嘈杂.zh: 在这么嘈杂的环境中无法学习。
嘈杂.pinyin: Zài zhè me cáo zá de huán jìng zhōng wú fǎ xué xí
嘈杂.en: One cannot study in such noise.
嘈杂.es: No se puede estudiar con tanto ruido.

嘈杂.pinyin: Gēn tā xiāng bǐ tā cáo zá
嘈杂.en: Compared with him, she is very noisy.

声明.zh: 她承认我的声明是真实的。
声明.pinyin: Tā chéng rèn wǒ de shēng míng shì zhēn shí de
声明.en: She acknowledged that my statement was true.

声明.zh: 声明的时机对警察的公众关系不利。
声明.pinyin: Shēng míng de shí jī duì jǐng chá de gōng zhòng guān xi bù lì
声明.en: The timing of the announcement hurts the public relations of the police.

无赖.pinyin: Tāng mǔ shì gè wú lài

无赖.zh: 这条街的居民大多是无赖。
无赖.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiē de jū mín dà duō shì wú lài
无赖.en: Most of the residents on this street are wrong 'uns.

自卑.zh: 我有什么办法可以脱离我的自卑情结吗？
自卑.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu shén me bàn fǎ kě yǐ tuō lí wǒ de zì bēi qíng jié ma
自卑.en: How can I rid myself of my inferiority complex?

自卑.pinyin: Tā zǒng shì hěn zì bēi

自卑.zh: 你虽然考试不及格，但也不必自卑。
自卑.pinyin: Nǐ suī rán kǎo shì bù jí gé dàn yě bù bì zì bēi
自卑.en: You needn't be ashamed because you failed the exam.

分散.zh: 我们分散开来并在树林中展开搜索。
分散.pinyin: Wǒ men fēn sàn kāi lái bìng zài shù lín zhōng zhǎn kāi sōu suǒ
分散.en: We spread out and began to search through the woods.

分散.zh: 与此同时江琴分散了江枫的哥哥燕大侠的注意力。
分散.pinyin: Yǔ cǐ tóng shí jiāng qín fēn sàn le jiāng fēng dī gē gē yān dà xiá de zhù yì lì
分散.en: Meanwhile, Jiang Qin distracted Jiang Feng's older brother Yan Daxia.

放大.zh: 这台显微镜能把物体放大一百倍。
放大.pinyin: Zhè tái xiǎn wēi jìng néng bǎ wù tǐ fàng dà yī bǎi bèi
放大.en: This microscope magnifies objects by 100 times.

时事.zh: 他组织了一场关於时事的课堂辩论。
时事.pinyin: Tā zǔ zhī le yī chǎng guān yú shí shì de kè táng biàn lùn
时事.en: He organized a classroom debate on current events.

听到.zh: 我期待听到你在这件事上的想法 。
听到.pinyin: Wǒ qī dài tīng dào nǐ zài zhè jiàn shì shàng de xiǎng fǎ
听到.en: I look forward to hearing your thoughts on this matter.
听到.es: Estoy impaciente por escuchar qué piensas de este tema.

听到.zh: 我听了，但什么也没听到。
听到.pinyin: Wǒ tīng le dàn shén me yě méi tīng dào
听到.en: I listened, but I didn't hear anything.

听到.zh: 我们听到所发生的事，感到很惊讶。
听到.pinyin: Wǒ men tīng dào suǒ fā shēng de shì gǎn dào hěn jīng yà
听到.en: We were astonished to hear what had happened.
听到.es: Nos sorprendió escuchar lo que había pasado.

听到.zh: 我听到这个消息很吃惊。
听到.pinyin: Wǒ tīng dào zhè ge xiāo xi hěn chī jīng
听到.en: I was surprised at the news.
听到.es: Me he sorprendido por la noticia.

开车.pinyin: Wǒ huì jiāo nǐ zěn me kāi chē
开车.en: I'll teach you how to drive a car.

开车.pinyin: Nǐ de mā ma huì kāi chē ma
开车.en: Can your mother drive a car?
He does not know how to drive a car.

开车.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi xué huì kāi chē
开车.en: I still haven't learned to drive a car.
开车.es: Todavía no he aprendido a conducir.

歌.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē ràng wǒ xiǎng jiā le
歌.en: The song reminds me of my home.
歌.es: Esta canción me hace pensar en mi hogar.

歌.zh: 我一听这首歌就会想起他的名字。
歌.pinyin: Wǒ yī tīng zhè shǒu gē jiù huì xiǎng qǐ tā de míng zi
歌.en: I think of his name every time I hear this song.
歌.es: Cada vez que escucho esta canción, pienso en él.

歌.zh: 我听过这首歌的法语版。
歌.pinyin: Wǒ tīng guo zhè shǒu gē de fǎ yǔ bǎn
歌.en: I heard the song sung in French.
歌.es: Oí esa canción cantada en francés.

歌.zh: 只要听到这首歌，我就会想起他们的笑容。
歌.pinyin: Zhǐ yào tīng dào zhè shǒu gē wǒ jiù huì xiǎng qǐ tā men de xiào róng
歌.en: Whenever I hear this song, I think of his smile.
歌.es: Siempre que oigo esta canción, pienso en su sonrisa.

桌.pinyin: Tā bǎ shū fàng zài le zhuō shàng
桌.en: He put the book on the table.
桌.es: Dejó el libro en la mesa.

桌.pinyin: Zhuō shàng yǒu yī běn shū
桌.en: There is a book on the desk.
桌.es: Hay un libro sobre el escritorio.

桌.pinyin: Zhuō shàng yǒu yī zhǐ chéng zi
桌.en: There is an orange on the table.
桌.es: Hay una naranja sobre la mesa.

桌.pinyin: Zhuō shàng yǒu gè píng guǒ
桌.en: There is an apple on the table.
桌.es: Hay una manzana sobre la mesa.

同一.pinyin: Wǒ men shàng tóng yī suǒ xué xiào
同一.en: We go to the same school.

同一.zh: 我和见次去同一间学校。
同一.pinyin: Wǒ hé jiàn cì qù tóng yī jiān xué xiào
同一.en: I go to the same school as Kenji.
同一.es: Voy al mismo colegio que Kenji.

同一.zh: 一只狐狸不会两次掉入同一个陷阱里。
同一.pinyin: Yī zhǐ hú li bù huì liǎng cì diào rù tóng yī gè xiàn jǐng lǐ
同一.en: A fox is not caught twice in the same snare.
同一.es: Un zorro nunca es capturado dos veces con el mismo cepo.

同一.zh: 埃菲尔铁塔和卢浮宫在同一座城市。
同一.pinyin: Āi fēi ěr tiě tǎ hé lú fú gōng zài tóng yī zuò chéng shì
同一.en: The Eiffel Tower is in the same city as the Louvre Museum.
同一.es: La Torre Eiffel está en la misma ciudad que el Museo del Louvre.

星期日.pinyin: Wǒ zài xīng qī rì bù gōng zuò
星期日.en: Sunday is not a workday for me.
星期日.es: El domingo no es un día de trabajo para mí.

星期日.zh: 他星期日并不总是在家。
星期日.pinyin: Tā xīng qī rì bìng bù zǒng shì zài jiā
星期日.en: He's not always at home on Sundays.
星期日.es: Él no siempre está en casa los domingos.

星期日.pinyin: Wǒ men fǎn duì xīng qī rì gōng zuò
星期日.en: We are against working on Sundays.
星期日.es: Estamos en contra de trabajar los domingos.

星期日.pinyin: Tā xīng qī rì zǒng shì zài jiā lǐ
星期日.en: He's always at home on Sundays.
星期日.es: Los domingos siempre está en casa.

听不懂.pinyin: Wǒ tīng bu dǒng tā de xiào hua

听不懂.zh: 我完全听不懂他说的话。
听不懂.pinyin: Wǒ wán quán tīng bu dǒng tā shuō de huà
听不懂.en: I did not understand him at all.

听不懂.pinyin: Nǐ shuō shén me tīng bu dǒng
听不懂.en: What did you say? I don't understand!

听不懂.zh: 他说的话我一句也听不懂。
听不懂.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà wǒ yī jù yě tīng bu dǒng
听不懂.en: I didn't understand in the least what he said.

上次.zh: 他比上次见面时胖了一些。
上次.pinyin: Tā bǐ shàng cì jiàn miàn shí pàng le yī xiē
上次.en: He is fatter than when I last saw him.
上次.es: Está más gordo de cuando lo vi por última vez.

上次.zh: 我上次计算，估计我已经学会了两千五百个汉字左右。
上次.pinyin: Wǒ shàng cì jì suàn gū jì wǒ yǐ jīng xué huì le liǎng qiān wǔ bǎi gè hàn zì zuǒ yòu
上次.en: Last time I counted, I estimated that I know around 2500 Chinese characters.
上次.es: La última vez que conté, calculé que me sabía alrededor de 2500 caracteres chinos.

上次.zh: 上次我见到她的时候，她看上去挺好的。
上次.pinyin: Shàng cì wǒ jiàn dào tā de shí hou tā kàn shang qu tǐng hǎo de
上次.en: She looked well when I last saw her.

上次.zh: 上次来吃的时候是很美味的。
上次.pinyin: Shàng cì lái chī de shí hou shì hěn měi wèi de
上次.en: Their food was great last time.

而言.pinyin: Jiù wǒ ér yán wǒ hěn mǎn yì
而言.en: As for me, I am satisfied.
而言.es: En lo que a mí concierne, estoy satisfecho.

而言.zh: 摄像机对我而言是必需品。
而言.pinyin: Shè xiàng jī duì wǒ ér yán shì bì xū pǐn
而言.en: The camera was essential for me.
而言.es: Para mi la cámara fue esencial.

而言.zh: 对於其他的六亿人口而言，英语不是第二语言就是外语。
而言.pinyin: Duì yú qí tā de liù yì rén kǒu ér yán yīng yǔ bù shì dì èr yǔ yán jiù shì wài yǔ
而言.en: For the other 600 million people, English is either a second language or a foreign language.
而言.es: Para los otros 600 millones de personas, el inglés es o una segunda lengua, o una lengua extranjera.

而言.pinyin: Zuò ér yán bù rú qǐ ér xíng
而言.es: Las acciones dicen más que las palabras.

晚点.pinyin: Wǒ wǎn diǎn dá gěi nǐ

晚点.zh: 火车晚点了，所以我不能准时赶到那里。
晚点.pinyin: Huǒ chē wǎn diǎn le suǒ yǐ wǒ bù néng zhǔn shí gǎn dào nà li
晚点.en: The train was delayed, so I could not arrive there on time.
晚点.es: El tren se retrasó, así que no pude llegar a tiempo.

晚点.pinyin: Duì bu qǐ huǒ chē wǎn diǎn le
晚点.es: Lo siento. El tren llegó con retraso.

晚点.zh: 你可以晚点再打电话来吗？
晚点.pinyin: Nǐ kě yǐ wǎn diǎn zài dǎ diàn huà lái ma
晚点.en: Could you call again later, please?

百万.zh: 他们的损失到达了一百万日圆。
百万.pinyin: Tā men de sǔn shī dào dá le yī bǎi wàn rì yuán
百万.en: Their losses reached one million yen.
百万.es: Sus pérdidas alcanzaron un millón de yenes.

百万.zh: 如果你有一百万円，你会用它来做甚么？
百万.pinyin: Rú guǒ nǐ yǒu yī bǎi wàn yuán nǐ huì yòng tā lái zuò shèn má
百万.en: Supposing you had one million yen, what would you do with it?
百万.es: Supón que tuvieras un millón de yenes, ¿qué harías con ellos?

百万.zh: 现在美国有三千一百万年龄在六十五岁以上的老人。
百万.pinyin: Xiàn zài měi guó yǒu sān qiān yī bǎi wàn nián líng zài liù shí wǔ suì yǐ shàng de lǎo rén
百万.en: At present there are about 31 million Americans over the age of sixty-five.
百万.es: Actualmente hay 31 millones de estadounidenses que tienen una edad mayor a los sesenta y cinco.

百万.zh: 损失高达了二百万美元。
百万.pinyin: Sǔn shī gāo dá le èr bǎi wàn měi yuán

放假.pinyin: Wǒ zhè ge xīng qī fàng jià le
放假.en: I am on holiday this week.

放假.zh: 你放假的时候做了什么？
放假.pinyin: Nǐ fàng jià de shí hou zuò le shén me
放假.en: What did you do during the holidays?

放假.zh: 不知道他放假的时候可不可以把结他借给我呢？
放假.pinyin: Bù zhī dào tā fàng jià de shí hou kě bu kě yǐ bǎ jiē tā jiè gěi wǒ ne
放假.en: I wonder if he can lend me his guitar during the vacation.
放假.es: Me pregunto si me prestará la guitarra durante las vacaciones.

放假.zh: 我们希望在放假前做完了工作。
放假.pinyin: Wǒ men xī wàng zài fàng jià qián zuò wán le gōng zuò
放假.en: We hoped to have done with the work before the holidays.
放假.es: Esperábamos terminar el trabajo antes de las fiestas.

付出.zh: 丑闻让他付出了失去声誉的代价。
付出.pinyin: Chǒu wén ràng tā fù chū le shī qù shēng yù de dài jià
付出.en: That scandal cost him his reputation.
付出.es: Este escándalo le ha costado su reputación.

付出.zh: 你愚蠢地行事，你会付出代价。
付出.pinyin: Nǐ yú chǔn de xíng shì nǐ huì fù chū dài jià
付出.en: You've acted foolishly and you will pay for it.
付出.es: Has actuado como un idiota y pagarás las consecuencias.

付出.zh: 世界上没有人能够不付出努力就获得成功。
付出.pinyin: Shì jiè shàng méi yǒu rén néng gòu bù fù chū nǔ lì jiù huò dé chéng gōng
付出.en: No one succeeds in the world without effort.
付出.es: Nadie tiene éxito en el mundo sin esfuerzo.

付出.zh: 上大学的时候，你得到的比付出的还多。
付出.pinyin: Shàng dà xué de shí hou nǐ dé dào de bǐ fù chū de hái duō
付出.en: You gain more than you spend when you go to college.

驾照.zh: 我母亲有驾照，但是她不开车。
驾照.pinyin: Wǒ mǔ qīn yǒu jià zhào dàn shì tā bù kāi chē
驾照.en: My mother has a driver's license, but she doesn't drive a car.
驾照.es: Mi mamá tiene licencia de conducir, pero no conduce un auto.

驾照.zh: 我想你要拿到驾照根本不难。
驾照.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng nǐ yào ná dào jià zhào gēn běn bù nán
驾照.en: I think you'll have very little difficulty in getting a driver's license.
驾照.es: Creo que tendrá muy poca dificultad en conseguir una licencia de conducir.

驾照.zh: 我想您要拿到驾照根本不难。
驾照.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng nín yào ná dào jià zhào gēn běn bù nán
驾照.en: I think you'll have very little difficulty in getting a driver's license.
驾照.es: Creo que tendrá muy poca dificultad en conseguir una licencia de conducir.

驾照.pinyin: Tā méi dào ná jià zhào de nián líng
驾照.en: She's not old enough to get a driver's license.
驾照.es: Ella no es bastante mayor para sacar un carné de conducción.

图片.zh: 他们给我们看他们全部的家庭图片。
图片.pinyin: Tā men gěi wǒ men kàn tā men quán bù de jiā tíng tú piàn
图片.en: We were shown all of their family photos.
图片.es: Nos mostraron todas las fotos familiares.

图片.zh: 图片的背景是一座城堡。
图片.pinyin: Tú piàn de bèi jǐng shì yī zuò chéng bǎo
图片.en: There is a castle in the background of the picture.
图片.es: Hay un castillo en el fondo de esa pintura.

图片.pinyin: Qǐng kàn kàn yè dǐng de tú piàn
图片.en: Look at the picture at the top of the page.
图片.es: Observa la imagen en la parte superior de la página.

图片.zh: 为什么你要烧这些图片呢？
图片.pinyin: Wèi shén me nǐ yào shāo zhè xiē tú piàn ne
图片.en: Why are you burning these pictures?

界.zh: 如果可能的话我想去世界各地旅行。
界.pinyin: Rú guǒ kě néng de huà wǒ xiǎng qù shì jiè gè dì lǚ xíng
界.en: I want to go on a journey around the world if possible.
界.es: Quiero ir a un viaje alrededor del mundo, si es posible.

界.zh: 他可能还在世界的某一个角落里生存着。
界.pinyin: Tā kě néng hái zài shì jiè de mǒu yī ge jiǎo luò lǐ shēng cún zhe
界.en: He could still be alive somewhere.
界.es: Él podría seguir vivo en algún lado.

界.zh: 英语是目前在世界上使用最广泛的语言。
界.pinyin: Yīng yǔ shì mù qián zài shì jiè shàng shǐ yòng zuì guǎng fàn de yǔ yán
界.en: English is by far the most widely-spoken language in the world.
界.es: El inglés es de lejos el idioma más hablado del mundo.

界.zh: 知名文学界人士昨晚齐聚一堂。
界.pinyin: Zhī míng wén xué jiè rén shì zuó wǎn qí jù yī táng
界.en: Noted literary personalities gathered together last evening.

芝加哥.zh: 汤姆在芝加哥住了一年。
芝加哥.pinyin: Tāng mǔ zài zhī jiā gē zhù le yī nián
芝加哥.en: Tom has lived in Chicago for a year.
芝加哥.es: Tom vive en Chicago desde hace un año.

芝加哥.zh: 我下周将离开去芝加哥。
芝加哥.pinyin: Wǒ xià zhōu jiāng lí kāi qù zhī jiā gē
芝加哥.en: I'm leaving for Chicago next week.
芝加哥.es: La semana próxima voy a Chicago.

芝加哥.pinyin: Tā men zuò chē qù zhī jiā gē
芝加哥.en: They went to Chicago by car.

芝加哥.pinyin: Kǎ luó zhù zài zhī jiā gē

芬兰.zh: 我是芬兰人，但我也说瑞典语。
芬兰.pinyin: Wǒ shì fēn lán rén dàn wǒ yě shuō ruì diǎn yǔ
芬兰.en: I am Finnish, but I speak also Swedish.
芬兰.es: Soy finés, pero hablo sueco también.

芬兰.zh: 我不能学芬兰语，因为我不想住在芬兰。
芬兰.pinyin: Wǒ bù néng xué fēn lán yǔ yīn wèi wǒ bù xiǎng zhù zài fēn lán
芬兰.en: I cannot learn Finnish because I don't want to live in Finland.
芬兰.es: No puedo aprender finés porque no quiero vivir en Finlandia.

同.zh: 不管你同不同意，我都要做。
同.pinyin: Bù guǎn nǐ tóng bù tóng yì wǒ dōu yào zuò
同.en: I am going to do it whether you agree or not.
同.es: Estés de acuerdo o no, voy a hacerlo.

同.pinyin: Nǐ hé nǐ de fù mǔ tóng zhù ma
同.en: Do you live with your parents?

同.zh: 我同他们没有过共同之处。
同.pinyin: Wǒ tóng tā men méi yǒu guo gòng tóng zhī chǔ
同.en: I had nothing in common with them.
同.es: Yo no tenía nada en común con ellos.

同.pinyin: Tā men duì hé tóng hěn mǎn yì
同.en: They are satisfied with the contract.
同.es: Ellos están satisfechos con el contrato.

意大利语.zh: 他的夫人是我们的意大利语老师。
意大利语.pinyin: Tā de fū ren shì wǒ men de yì dà lì yǔ lǎo shī
意大利语.en: His wife is our Italian teacher.
意大利语.es: Su mujer es nuestra profesora de italiano.

意大利语.pinyin: Yì dà lì yǔ shì wǒ de mǔ yǔ
意大利语.es: El italiano es mi lengua materna.

意大利语.zh: 我从意大利来了，我会说意大利语。
意大利语.pinyin: Wǒ cóng yì dà lì lái le wǒ huì shuō yì dà lì yǔ
意大利语.en: I come from Italy and I speak Italian.
意大利语.es: Vengo de Italia y hablo italiano.

意大利语.zh: 你在哪里学的意大利语？
意大利语.pinyin: Nǐ zài nǎ lǐ xué de yì dà lì yǔ

神户.pinyin: Shén hù shì wǒ chū shēng de chéng shì
神户.en: Kobe is the city which I was born in.
神户.es: Kobe es la ciudad donde nací.

神户.pinyin: Wǒ chéng huǒ chē qù le shén hù
神户.en: I went to Kobe by train.

神户.pinyin: Wǒ mèi mei zuó tiān qù shén hù le
神户.en: My sister went to Kobe yesterday.
神户.es: Mi hermana fue a Kobe ayer.

神户.pinyin: Nǐ zài shén hù duō jiǔ le
神户.en: How long have you been in Kobe?

脸颊.zh: 她在他的脸颊上吻了一下。
脸颊.pinyin: Tā zài tā de liǎn jiá shàng wěn le yī xià
脸颊.en: She kissed him on the cheek.
脸颊.es: Ella lo besó en la mejilla.

脸颊.pinyin: Tā qīn wěn tā de liǎn jiá
脸颊.en: She kissed him on the cheek.
脸颊.es: Ella lo besó en la mejilla.

脸颊.zh: 汤姆的脸颊上有一块伤痕。
脸颊.pinyin: Tāng mǔ de liǎn jiá shàng yǒu yī kuài shāng hén
脸颊.en: Tom has a scar on his cheek.
脸颊.es: Tom tiene una cicatriz en el cachete.

脸颊.pinyin: Tāng mǔ qīn le mǎ lì liǎn jiá
脸颊.en: Tom kissed Mary on the cheek.
脸颊.es: Tom besó a Mary en la mejilla.

西班牙人.pinyin: Wǒ shì xī bān yá rén
Nǐ shì xī bān yá rén shì bu shì
Wǒ zhī dào tā shì xī bān yá rén
西班牙人.en: I know that she is Spanish.

西班牙人.zh: 你的爸爸是西班牙人吗？
西班牙人.pinyin: Nǐ de bà ba shì xī bān yá rén ma

里加.zh: 请再在我的茶里加点牛奶。
里加.pinyin: Qǐng zài zài wǒ de chá lǐ jiā diǎn niú nǎi
里加.en: Add a little more milk to my tea, please.
里加.es: Ponle un poco más de leche a mi té, por favor.

里加.zh: 我妈妈忘了往沙拉里加盐了。
里加.pinyin: Wǒ mā ma wàng le wǎng shā lā lǐ jiā yán le
里加.en: My mom forgot to add salt to the salad.
里加.es: A mi madre se le olvidó echarle sal a la ensalada.

里加.zh: 你需要往花瓶里加更多的水。
里加.pinyin: Nǐ xū yào wǎng huā píng lǐ jiā gèng duō de shuǐ
里加.en: You need to put more water in the vase.
里加.es: Es necesario poner más agua en el florero.

里加.zh: 我从来不在我的咖啡里加糖。
里加.pinyin: Wǒ cóng lái bù zài wǒ de kā fēi lǐ jiā táng
里加.en: I never put sugar in my coffee.

开学.pinyin: Míng tiān jiù kāi xué le

开学.zh: 欧洲的学校在九月开学。
开学.pinyin: Ōu zhōu de xué xiào zài jiǔ yuè kāi xué
开学.en: School starts in September in Europe.
开学.es: En Europa, las clases empiezan en septiembre.

开学.zh: 开学了，目前感觉还不错。
开学.pinyin: Kāi xué le mù qián gǎn jué hái bù cuò
开学.en: School has started and I like it so far.
开学.es: He empezado la escuela, y hasta ahora no me desagrada.
La escuela empieza el lunes que viene.

面试.pinyin: Nǐ de miàn shì zěn me yàng
Wǒ jīn tiān yǒu gè miàn shì

面试.zh: 您好，我跟总经理有约十点见面，这是我的面试通知。
面试.pinyin: Nín hǎo wǒ gēn zǒng jīng lǐ yǒu yāo shí diǎn jiàn miàn zhè shì wǒ de miàn shì tōng zhī
面试.en: Hi, I have an appointment with the general manager. This is my interview notice.

面试.zh: 这次面试的意义是评断你适不适合这家公司。
面试.pinyin: Zhè cì miàn shì de yì yì shì píng duàn nǐ shì bù shì gě zhè jiā gōng sī
面试.en: The purpose of this interview is to assess whether or not you are suitable for the company.

一堆.zh: 父亲生前留下来的老古董，原来只是一堆不值钱的垃圾。
一堆.pinyin: Fù qīn shēng qián liú xià lái de lǎo gǔ dǒng yuán lái zhǐ shì yī duī bù zhí qián de lā jī
一堆.en: The antiques my father left when he died turned out to be nothing but worthless junk.
一堆.es: Las antigüedades que dejó mi padre al morir resultaron no ser más que basura inútil.

一堆.zh: 我吃了一堆塔可钟，现在肚子拉得很惨。
一堆.pinyin: Wǒ chī le yī duī tǎ kě zhōng xiàn zài dù zi lā de hěn cǎn
一堆.en: I ate a bunch of Taco Bell and now I have a serious case of the shits.

一堆.zh: 汤姆和一堆陌生人在一起。
一堆.pinyin: Tāng mǔ hé yī duī mò shēng rén zài yī qǐ
一堆.en: Tom was with a bunch of strangers.

做错.zh: 据我所知，他没做错任何事。
做错.pinyin: Jù wǒ suǒ zhī tā méi zuò cuò rèn hé shì
做错.en: As far as I know, he did nothing wrong.
做错.es: Hasta donde yo sé, él no hizo nada mal.

做错.zh: 我小时候做错事就会被打屁股。
做错.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎo shí hou zuò cuò shì jiù huì bèi dǎ pì gu
做错.en: When I was a child, I was spanked if I did something wrong.
做错.es: Cuando era pequeño, me daban unos azotes cuando hacía algo malo.

做错.zh: 他终於醒觉到自己做错了。
做错.pinyin: Tā zhōng yú xǐng jiào dào zì jǐ zuò cuò le
做错.en: At last, he realized his error.
做错.es: Por fin se dio cuenta de su error.

家庭作业.zh: 我已经做了我的家庭作业。
家庭作业.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ jīng zuò le wǒ de jiā tíng zuò yè
家庭作业.en: I have already done my homework.

家庭作业.zh: 请帮我做我的家庭作业。
家庭作业.pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ zuò wǒ de jiā tíng zuò yè
家庭作业.en: Please help me with my homework.
家庭作业.es: Por favor, ayúdame con mi tarea.

家庭作业.zh: 我帮他做他的家庭作业。
家庭作业.pinyin: Wǒ bāng tā zuò tā de jiā tíng zuò yè
家庭作业.en: I helped him with his homework.

家庭作业.zh: 我需要更多时间来完成我的家庭作业。
家庭作业.pinyin: Wǒ xū yào gèng duō shí jiān lái wán chéng wǒ de jiā tíng zuò yè
家庭作业.en: I need more time to finish my homework.
家庭作业.es: Necesito más tiempo para terminar mi tarea.

长颈鹿.pinyin: Cháng jǐng lù shì zěn me jiào de
长颈鹿.en: What sound does a giraffe make?

长颈鹿.zh: 新生的长颈鹿摇晃著腿跌跌撞撞地走。
长颈鹿.pinyin: Xīn shēng de cháng jǐng lù yáo huàng zhe tuǐ diē die zhuàng zhuàng de zǒu
长颈鹿.en: The newborn giraffe stumbled around on rickety legs.
长颈鹿.es: La jirafa recién nacida se tambaleaba sobre sus patas raquíticas.

长颈鹿.zh: 他们发现了一具长颈鹿的尸体。
长颈鹿.pinyin: Tā men fā xiàn le yī jù cháng jǐng lù de shī tǐ

长颈鹿.zh: 这个国家只剩下少量的长颈鹿。
长颈鹿.pinyin: Zhè ge guó jiā zhǐ shèng xià shǎo liàng de cháng jǐng lù
长颈鹿.en: Only small populations of giraffes remain in this country.

弄伤.zh: 我今天早上刮胡子的时候把自己弄伤了。
弄伤.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān zǎo shang guā hú zi de shí hou bǎ zì jǐ nòng shāng le
弄伤.en: I cut myself shaving this morning.

弄伤.pinyin: Tāng mǔ nòng shāng le zì jǐ

弄伤.zh: 罗杰在冰上滑倒了，弄伤了腿。
弄伤.pinyin: Luó jié zài bīng shàng huá dǎo le nòng shāng le tuǐ
弄伤.en: Roger slipped on the ice and hurt his leg.
弄伤.es: Roger se resbaló en el hielo y se hizo daño en la pierna.

弄伤.pinyin: Tā diē dǎo nòng shāng le tā de shǒu
弄伤.en: He fell and hurt his hand.

灌.pinyin: Jiǔ shì guàn rù píng zhòng dì shī
灌.es: Vino es poesía puesto en botellas.

灌.pinyin: Tā bǎ píng zi guàn mǎn le shuǐ
灌.en: He filled the bottle with water.

灌.pinyin: Qǐng yòng kāi shuǐ bǎ chá hú guàn mǎn
灌.en: Please fill the teapot with boiling water.
灌.es: Llena la tetera con agua hirviendo por favor.

灌.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shuǐ píng guàn mǎn
灌.es: Por favor, llená esta botella de agua.

受害者.pinyin: Tā bù shì shòu hài zhě

受害者.zh: 亵渎是没有受害者的犯罪。
受害者.pinyin: Xiè dú shì méi yǒu shòu hài zhě de fàn zuì
受害者.es: La blasfemia es un crimen sin víctima.

受害者.pinyin: Shéi huì shì xià yī ge shòu hài zhě
受害者.en: Who would be its next victim?

受害者.pinyin: Tā shì zhè jiàn shì de shòu hài zhě
受害者.en: She is the victim of this incident.

牌.pinyin: Diū qì yī zhāng shǒu pái

牌.zh: 乔纳森吃牌了，因为与对方球员打架。
牌.pinyin: Qiáo nà sēn chī pái le yīn wèi yǔ duì fāng qiú yuán dǎ jià
牌.en: Jonathan was booked because he got into a fight with a player on the other team.

评判.zh: 不要做评判，这样您自己才不会被人评判。
评判.pinyin: Bù yào zuò píng pàn zhè yàng nín zì jǐ cái bù huì bèi rén píng pàn
评判.en: Do not judge, or you too will be judged.
评判.es: No juzguéis, para que no seáis juzgados.

评判.zh: 我们应该根据他的作为来评判他。
评判.pinyin: Wǒ men yīng gāi gēn jù tā de zuò wéi lái píng pàn tā
评判.en: We should judge him according to his actions.

评判.zh: 对你来说，我们可不可以评判别人的宗教？
评判.pinyin: Duì nǐ lái shuō wǒ men kě bu kě yǐ píng pàn bié ren de zōng jiào
评判.en: In your view, can we judge other people's religion or not?

评判.zh: 据说美国人把一个人的收入视为评判他能力的重要尺度。
评判.pinyin: Jù shuō měi guó rén bǎ yī gè rén de shōu rù shì wéi píng pàn tā néng lì de zhòng yào chǐ dù
评判.en: Americans are said to regard the amount of money a man makes as a criterion of his ability.

嘴里.zh: 我看到了一条狗。狗嘴里叼着一块肉。
嘴里.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào le yī tiáo gǒu gǒu zuǐ lǐ diāo zhe yī kuài ròu
嘴里.en: I saw a dog. The dog held a piece of meat in its mouth.
嘴里.es: Vi un perro. El perro llevaba un trozo de carne en la boca.

嘴里.zh: 嘴里有东西的时候不准说话。
嘴里.pinyin: Zuǐ lǐ yǒu dōng xi de shí hou bù zhǔn shuō huà
嘴里.en: You must not speak with your mouth full.
嘴里.es: No hables con la boca llena.

嘴里.zh: 瑞士巧克力真的在你嘴里融化。
嘴里.pinyin: Ruì shì qiǎo kè lì zhēn de zài nǐ zuǐ lǐ róng huà
嘴里.en: Swiss chocolate really melts in your mouth.
嘴里.es: El chocolate suizo realmente se derrite en la boca.

嘴里.zh: 橙子在我嘴里留下了一种奇怪的味道。
嘴里.pinyin: Chéng zi zài wǒ zuǐ lǐ liú xià le yī zhǒng qí guài de wèi dao
嘴里.en: The orange left a strange taste in my mouth.

太空人.zh: 她的未婚夫是一个太空人。
太空人.pinyin: Tā de wèi hūn fū shì yī ge tài kōng rén
太空人.en: The man whom she is going to marry is an astronaut.
太空人.es: El hombre con quien se va a casar es astronauta.

太空人.zh: 她将会成为日本第一个女性太空人。
太空人.pinyin: Tā jiāng huì chéng wéi rì běn dì yī gè nǚ xìng tài kōng rén
太空人.en: She will be the first Japanese woman astronaut.
太空人.es: Ella será la primera mujer japonesa astronauta.

太空人.pinyin: Tài kōng rén wèi fā shè zuò zhǔn bèi

掌.zh: 我不弯膝也能把手掌平放在地上。
掌.pinyin: Wǒ bù wān xī yě néng bǎ shǒu zhǎng píng fàng zài dì shàng
掌.en: I can place the palms of my hands on the floor without bending my knees.
掌.es: Puedo poner las palmas de mis manos sobre el piso sin doblar las rodillas.

掌.zh: 来人，给我掌这贱女人嘴巴！
掌.pinyin: Lái rén gěi wǒ zhǎng zhè jiàn nǚ rén zuǐ ba
掌.en: Guards! Slap that vile woman's face!

掌.zh: 他对她的过去似乎瞭如指掌。
掌.pinyin: Tā duì tā de guò qù sì hū liǎo rú zhǐ zhǎng
掌.en: He seems to know all about her past.

掌.zh: 我对掌上阅读很感兴趣。
掌.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhǎng shàng yuè dú hěn gǎn xìng qù
掌.en: I am interested in palm reading.

煤气.pinyin: Wǒ gāi zài nǎr fù méi qì fèi
煤气.en: Where do I pay for the gas?

煤气.zh: 出门前记得检查一下煤气是否关好了。
煤气.pinyin: Chū mén qián jì de jiǎn chá yī xià méi qì shì fǒu guān hǎo le
煤气.en: Before you go out remember to check the gas is turned off.

细心.zh: 他每件事做之前都会细心计划。
细心.pinyin: Tā měi jiàn shì zuò zhī qián dū huì xì xīn jì huà
细心.en: He always plans a thing out carefully before he does it.
细心.es: Él siempre planea una cosa cuidadosamente antes de hacerla.

细心.zh: 他的工作表现得很不细心。
细心.pinyin: Tā de gōng zuò biǎo xiàn de hěn bù xì xīn

细心.zh: 只要你细心想一想，就会明白自己的错处了。
细心.pinyin: Zhǐ yào nǐ xì xīn xiǎng yī xiǎng jiù huì míng bai zì jǐ de cuò chu le
细心.en: A little reflection will show you that you are wrong.

职.zh: 汤姆在考虑担任教练一职。
职.pinyin: Tāng mǔ zài kǎo lǜ dān rèn jiào liàn yī zhí
职.en: Tom is considering taking a coaching job.

职.pinyin: Jié kè hěn shī wàng bìng cí le zhí
职.en: Jack was really disappointed, and left his job.

职.zh: 俊杰今天请假，好像去考公职。
职.pinyin: Jùn jié jīn tiān qǐng jià hǎo xiàng qù kǎo gōng zhí
职.en: Chun-chieh took the day off. I think he's taking the civil service exam.

自我.pinyin: Nǐ yǒng yuǎn dōu bù néng tài zì wǒ
自我.en: You can never have too much ego.

自我.zh: 自我怀疑是聪明的第一标志。
自我.pinyin: Zì wǒ huái yí shì cōng ming de dì yī biāo zhì
自我.en: To have doubts about oneself is the first sign of intelligence.
自我.es: Dudar de sí mismo es la primera señal de inteligencia.

自我.zh: 她在镜前停下脚步，自我欣赏了一番。
自我.pinyin: Tā zài jìng qián tíng xià jiǎo bù zì wǒ xīn shǎng le yī fān
自我.en: She stopped before the mirror to admire herself.
自我.es: Se paró frente al espejo para admirarse a sí misma.

自我.zh: 在人类自我毁灭的边缘，第一次接触成了福音。
自我.pinyin: Zài rén lèi zì wǒ huǐ miè de biān yuán dì yī cì jiē chù chéng le fú yīn
自我.en: First Contact became humanity's salvation as it was at the brink of self-destruction.

遮住.zh: 当你在阳光下的时候，遮住你的头。
遮住.pinyin: Dāng nǐ zài yáng guāng xià de shí hou zhē zhù nǐ de tou
遮住.en: Cover your head when you are in the sun.
遮住.es: Cúbrete la cabeza cuando estés al sol.

遮住.zh: 她的新发型遮住了耳朵。
遮住.pinyin: Tā de xīn fà xíng zhē zhù le ěr duo
遮住.en: Her new hairstyle covers her ears.
遮住.es: Su nuevo corte de cabello le cubre las orejas.

遮住.zh: 巨大的柱子遮住了视线，让人看不到湖。
遮住.pinyin: Jù dà de zhù zi zhē zhù le shì xiàn ràng rén kàn bù dào hú
遮住.en: A large pillar obstructs the view of the lake.
遮住.es: Un gran pilar obstruye la vista al lago.

遮住.pinyin: Yuè liang bèi yún zhē zhù le
遮住.en: The moon is behind the clouds.
遮住.es: La luna está detrás de las nubes.

两头.zh: 他养了两头猫：一头是黑色的，一头是白色的。
两头.pinyin: Tā yǎng le liǎng tóu māo yī tóu shì hēi sè de yī tóu shì bái sè de
两头.en: He keeps two cats: one is black, and the other white.
两头.es: Él tiene dos gatos: uno es negro y el otro blanco.

两头.pinyin: Cūn lǐ yǒu liǎng tóu mǔ niú
两头.en: There are two cows in the village.
两头.es: Hay dos vacas en el pueblo.

多方.zh: 我想你迟早会知道在桌面建立一个快捷方式是有多方便。
多方.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng nǐ chí zǎo huì zhī dào zài zhuō miàn jiàn lì yī ge kuài jié fāng shì shì yǒu duō fāng biàn
多方.en: I think you will find it convenient to put a short-cut on the desktop.

多方.zh: 物价上涨是多方因素造成的。
多方.pinyin: Wù jià shàng zhǎng shì duō fāng yīn sù zào chéng de
多方.en: Several factors operated to help prices go up.

多方.zh: 这个项目要多方合作才能完成。
多方.pinyin: Zhè ge xiàng mù yào duō fāng hé zuò cái néng wán chéng
多方.en: Completing this project would require the cooperation of multiple parties.

工作日.zh: 星期天不是我的工作日。
工作日.pinyin: Xīng qī tiān bù shì wǒ de gōng zuò rì
工作日.en: Sunday is not a workday for me.
工作日.es: El domingo no es un día de trabajo para mí.

工作日.zh: 我们的工作人员会在三个工作日内联系您。
工作日.pinyin: Wǒ men de gōng zuò rén yuán huì zài sān gè gōng zuò rì nèi lián xì nín
工作日.en: Our staff will contact you in three working days.

工作日.zh: 这间公司的工作日为星期一到星期五。
工作日.pinyin: Zhè jiān gōng sī de gōng zuò rì wèi xīng qī yī dào xīng qī wǔ
工作日.en: Monday through Friday are work-days in this company.

工作日.zh: 工作日是：周一，周二，周三，周四，和周五。
工作日.pinyin: Gōng zuò rì shì zhōu yī zhōu èr zhōu sān zhōu sì hé zhōu wǔ
工作日.en: The weekdays are: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday.

放过.pinyin: Fàng guò wǒ ba shòu bù liǎo le
放过.en: Let me go. I can't take it anymore!

放过.pinyin: Fàng guò nà ge kě lián rén

敌.zh: 她是一名无人能敌的歌手。
敌.pinyin: Tā shì yī míng wú rén néng dí de gē shǒu
敌.en: She is a singer without equal.

敌.pinyin: Ái zhèng shì rén lèi de dà dí
敌.en: Cancer is a great enemy of humanity.
敌.es: El cáncer es un gran enemigo de la humanidad.

敌.zh: 在厨房，家用洗碗机可以算得上是手洗刷碗工的大敌。
敌.pinyin: Zài chú fáng jiā yòng xǐ wǎn jī kě yǐ suàn de shàng shì shǒu xǐ shuā wǎn gōng de dà dí
敌.en: The washing-up machine at home was regarded as a rival to the worker at the kitchen sink.
敌.es: El lavaplatos de casa fue considerado una amenaza por el encargado del fregadero.

敌.pinyin: Áo yè shì pí fū de dà dí
敌.en: Staying up late is terrible for your skin.

比不上.zh: 我的厨艺比不上我的母亲。
比不上.pinyin: Wǒ de chú yì bǐ bù shàng wǒ de mǔ qīn
比不上.en: I cannot cook as well as my mother does.
比不上.es: No sé cocinar tan bien como mi madre.

比不上.zh: 他在各方面都比不上你。
比不上.pinyin: Tā zài gè fāng miàn dōu bǐ bù shàng nǐ
比不上.en: He is inferior to you in all respects.

比不上.zh: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。
比不上.pinyin: Rén zào pí gé shì bǐ bù shàng zhēn pí de
比不上.en: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.

涌.zh: 数以千计的人涌向了诺姆。
涌.pinyin: Shù yǐ qiān jì de rén chōng xiàng le nuò mǔ
涌.en: Thousands of people rushed to Nome.

涌.zh: 洪水涌到了窗户的高度。
涌.pinyin: Hóng shuǐ chōng dào le chuāng hu de gāo dù
涌.en: The flood water reached the level of the windows.

涌.zh: 梅纳德的焦虑感涌了上来。
涌.pinyin: Méi nà dé de jiāo lǜ gǎn yǒng le shàng lái

涌.zh: 人群从体育馆中涌了出来。
涌.pinyin: Rén qún cóng tǐ yù guǎn zhōng yǒng le chū lái
涌.en: The crowd poured out of the gym.

萌.pinyin: Nǐ de zhè shuāng tuō xié hěn méng
萌.en: Your pair of slippers are very cute.

萌.pinyin: Nǐ jué de zhè ge dōng xi méng ma
萌.en: Do you think this thing is cute?

赌.pinyin: Wǒ dǔ shàng wǒ de míng shēng
赌.en: I'll stake my reputation on it.

赌.pinyin: Wǒ dǔ tā yíng zhè bǐ sài
赌.en: I made a bet that she would win the game.

赌.zh: 我和你赌一百元，汤姆是同性恋。
赌.pinyin: Wǒ hé nǐ dǔ yī bǎi yuán tāng mǔ shì tóng xìng liàn
赌.en: I'll bet you a hundred dollars that Tom is gay.

赌.pinyin: Wǒ dǔ míng tiān huì xià yǔ
赌.en: I bet it will rain tomorrow.

上锁.zh: 你没有把你的车上锁吗？
上锁.pinyin: Nǐ méi yǒu bǎ nǐ de chē shàng suǒ ma
上锁.en: Didn't you lock up your car?

上锁.zh: 令我惊讶的是，门没上锁。
上锁.pinyin: Lǐng wǒ jīng yà de shì mén méi shàng suǒ
上锁.en: To my surprise, the door was unlocked.
上锁.es: Para mi sorpresa, la puerta estaba abierta.

上锁.pinyin: Wǒ wàng jì gěi chōu ti shàng suǒ le
上锁.en: I forgot to lock the drawer.
上锁.es: Se me olvidó cerrar con llave el cajón.

上锁.pinyin: Zhè ge mén huì zì jǐ shàng suǒ

不简单.pinyin: Zhè ge wèn tí bù jiǎn dān

不简单.zh: 英语不简单，但是很有趣。
不简单.pinyin: Yīng yǔ bù jiǎn dān dàn shì hěn yǒu qù
不简单.en: English is not easy, but it is interesting.
不简单.es: El inglés no es fácil, pero es interesante.

作战.zh: 首先他们嘲笑你，其次他们和你作战，然后你赢了。
作战.pinyin: Shǒu xiān tā men cháo xiào nǐ qí cì tā men hé nǐ zuò zhàn rán hòu nǐ yíng le
作战.en: First they laugh at you, then they fight you, and then you win.
作战.es: Primero se ríen de ti, luego se pelean contigo, y luego ganas.

作战.zh: 民兵雕像是为了纪念独立战争中英勇作战的士兵。
